column1: # BF3AI weapon loadouts. One row = one weapon set-up. Each life every bot picks one row at random (weighted) among the rows for its class.
# class: Assault | Heavy | Sniper | Officer | Any.  'Any' rows are used only for classes that have no row of their own.  weight: relative chance (0 = disabled).
# weapon: name of a weapon prefab in Assets/Resources/<Weapons folder>/ (the same prefabs WeaponManager loads). Leave empty for no model (a generated tracer is used).
# fireRate: trigger pulls per second. spread: weapon spread in degrees
column2: added to the bot's own aim error. magazine: >100 = infinite. range: metres
0 = from the weapon's Blaster. projectiles: per firepoint per pull (shotguns). burst/burstDelay: pulls per burst. spool: seconds before first shot.

column1: # Lines starting with # are ignored. Columns can be in any order as long as the header row names them. After editing
column2: restart play mode (or use the SquadManager menu: BF3AI > Reload Loadouts CSV).
